(17β)-2-Methox- yestra-1,3,5(10)-triene-3,17-diol. C19H26O3 = 302.4. CAS — 362-07-2. Profile 2-Methoxyoestradiol is a metabolite of oestradiol (p.2097). It does not exhibit direct oestrogenic activity, but works through multiple cellular pathways to produce antineoplastic effects, in- cluding inhibition of angiogenesis and induction of apoptosis. 2-Methoxyoestradiol is under investigation in the treatment of various diseases, including glioblastoma, multiple myeloma, carcinoid tumours, as well as ovarian, prostate, breast, and renal cell cancers. It is also under investigation for pulmonary arterial hypertension.
